title: Event Video
caption: This video highlights EyeGuard's outreach at the 2026 Highlight International Art Festival, where I shared the app's mission of helping families catch potential eye health problems early and promote better eye disease awareness in the community.

title: Event Video
caption: In this news-style interview from the 2026 Highlight International Art Festival at Bowers Museum, I introduced EyeGuard and shared its mission of helping families detect potential eye health problems like myopia early. The interview helped promote EyeGuard's focus on myopia prevention, early awareness, and accessible vision health education for the community.

title: Event Video
caption: In this video, I promoted EyeGuard to two Bowers Museum executives and shared the app's mission of supporting early eye health awareness and myopia prevention. This conversation helped introduce EyeGuard to local community leaders and expand its outreach beyond families at the event.
